proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9201 *bājjara lists Hindi bājrā/bājṛā, Punjabi bājrā, Gujarati bājrī and Marathi bājrā for millet. The link identifies this comparative grain-name family; the addendum criticizes a proposed deeper reconstruction, and no particular botanical species is imposed on the survey gloss.
